description: This Scala source file defines the ExecuteResponseObserver class, which manages caching, response handling, and synchronization for responses in a Spark SQL connect execution context. It implements a StreamObserver to process responses, handle errors, and manage cached responses for reattachment and retries.

classes.name: ExecuteResponseObserver
classes.description: A class that observes and manages responses during Spark SQL connect execution, handling caching, synchronization, and response lifecycle.

methods.name: tryOnNext
methods.description: Attempts to add a response to the cache; returns false if the stream is finished.

methods.name: onNext
methods.description: Adds a response to the cache, throws if the stream is completed.

methods.name: onNextComplete
methods.description: Adds a response and marks the stream as complete.

methods.name: onError
methods.description: Records an error and marks the stream as finished.

methods.name: consumeResponse
methods.description: Retrieves and marks a response as consumed, managing cache accordingly.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the stream error if any.

methods.name: getLastResponseIndex
methods.description: Returns the index of the last response if stream is finished.

methods.name: getResponseIndexById
methods.description: Retrieves the response index for a given response ID.

methods.name: removeResponsesUntilId
methods.description: Removes cached responses up to a specified response ID.

methods.name: completed
methods.description: Checks if the stream is finished.

methods.name: isCleaned
methods.description: Checks if the observer has been cleaned up.

methods.name: undoCompletion
methods.description: Resets the completion state for testing.

methods.name: removeCachedResponses
methods.description: Removes cached responses based on retry buffer policy.

methods.name: removeResponsesUntilIndex
methods.description: Removes cached responses up to a specific index.

methods.name: setCommonResponseFields
methods.description: Sets common fields in responses before caching.

methods.name: getResponseId
methods.description: Extracts response ID from a response message.

methods.name: CachedSize
methods.description: Helper class for tracking size and count statistics of cached responses.
